newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's 6-mth T-bill yield falls to 45.01 pct. [CORRECTED 18:50 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Russia's 6-mth T-bill yield falls to 45.01 pct. [CORRECTED 18:50 GMT]

text.p: The annualised average yield on an issue of six-month GKO discount Treasury bills fell to 45.01 percent at an auction on Wednesday from 53.08 percent at the previous auction of six-month paper on November 13, the central bank said.
Full details of the auction follow --

Earlier the finance ministry also raised 2.67 trillion roubles by selling a new tranche of 105-day T-bills maturing in July at an average yield of 40.35 percent. That takes total proceeds from Wednesday's auctions to 7.63 (corrects from 9.39) trillion roubles.
The finance ministry has also repaid about 6.33 trillion roubles in maturing three-month bills (series 21068).
